deliveryTiming: GitHub scheduled jobs can be delayed. Reminders are evaluated at the actual invocation time; no real-time delivery guarantee.
activation: Set repository variable NOTIFICATION_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true only after the Production deployment is READY and its pilot scope is verified.
secret: NOTIFICATION_PRODUCTION_CRON_SECRET in GitHub Actions secrets must match Production-only CRON_SECRET. Never put either value in source, logs, cache or Preview.
scope: Use the existing Production organization/user pilot allowlists. TestRezidents is the only approved organization. No organization id is hardcoded in the workflow or application source.
execution: Only a scheduled event on main runs the accepted paginated runner. No push, pull request or manual business-handler trigger is configured. One workflow at a time, without interrupting an active run.
checkpoint: Restore the newest main-branch checkpoint cache and save after failures as well as success. The runner writes atomically after each successful page. GitHub cache eviction may restart a sweep; database occurrence/outbox uniqueness prevents duplication. Cache is an optimization, not a durable database. Reassess persistent storage before a larger rollout.
permissions: Read repository contents only; checkout credentials are not persisted. Actions are pinned to verified full commit SHAs. The runner needs only built-in Node modules; no application install or database credentials.
rollback: Disable NOTIFICATION_SCHEDULER_ENABLED first, restore Production flags and the recorded prior application deployment. No schema migration or DB rollback.
pilotQA: Create disposable synthetic Task, Case/client/date and Lead only in the approved organization, wait for a real scheduled invocation, retain occurrences for second-run dedupe, and request physical iPhone confirmation before exact-id cleanup.
